regions.purpose: The left half of the skinny peek — the Location's display name and coordinates. Identifies the Location the pin sits at.

The right half of the skinny peek — a vertically scrolling list of every Collection Entry that references this Location, one per Collection. Each row shows the owning Collection's name and appearance color and the Entry's visited/unvisited state.

shows: the Entry's visited or unvisited state

lists.emptyState: A Location with no Entries cannot be reached from MapOverview — pins exist only where there is at least one Entry. With exactly one Entry, the surface renders the EntryDrawer directly and this list is never shown.
